installInstructions.label: Important Install Instructions
installInstructions.html:
Here's what everything below does:

1. ADDON URL
Install this in Nuvio or Stremio. This gives you all your catalog rows on your home screen.

2. PUSH TO NUVIO (optional)
Skip the manual install — link your Nuvio account here and we'll add the addon and your collections straight to a profile for you.

3. DEVICE PROFILES (optional)
Save alternate versions of this setup — e.g. "4K TV" vs "Mobile" — each with its own install URL.

4. REGISTER EMAIL (optional)
Add your email so you can recover your token if you ever lose it. Never used for marketing.

5. YOUR TOKEN
This is your setup's password — save it somewhere safe. You'll need it to come back and edit this setup later.

6. NUVIO COLLECTIONS JSON (Nuvio users only)
After installing the addon URL, export and import this file in Nuvio → Collections. This gives you your folder and collection structure.

Simple rule: Addon URL = your catalog rows. Collections JSON = your folder layout.

Stremio users only need the Addon URL.
